title: SCS-001 Pipeline Restructuring — Cleanup + Registry + P1 Registration
description: Restructure SCS-001 into 3 named pipelines. Phase 1: purge 4GB deprecated content, create pipeline-registry.ts, register Pipeline 1 (Educational AI Avatar Style), rewrite batch-produce.ts to route through registry. Stubs for Pipeline 2 (Code Demo) and Pipeline 3 (Entertainment).

tasks.title: Purge deprecated content: multiformat-runs, legacy run dirs, old vlog runs, empty dirs (4GB freed)
Create pipeline-registry.ts with PipelineRunner interface, registerPipeline(), runPipeline(), metrics logging
Register Pipeline 1 (Educational AI Avatar Style) wrapping produce-vlog.ts
Create Pipeline 2 (Code Demo) and Pipeline 3 (Entertainment) stubs
Rewrite batch-produce.ts to route through pipeline-registry with --pipeline flag
